summary.zh: 面向唇腭裂青少年的双人 VR 教育与心理支持游戏，通过生活情境帮助建立自信和社会情感能力。
summary.en: A two-player VR educational and psychosocial support game helping young people with cleft conditions build confidence through real-life simulations.

zh: 支持自信、自尊和社会情感能力培养
en: Support confidence, self-esteem, and socioemotional skills

en: A 2023 UCSC article reported user testing across multiple countries

zh: 实现对话、文字、场景导航和 Photon 多人交互，参与面向唇腭裂青少年的 VR 支持游戏开发。
en: Implemented dialogue, text, navigation, and Photon multiplayer interaction for a VR support game.
